song.title: Because of You
song.lyrics:
[V1] .E A Because of You, I was born again . F#m7 B E Because of You, I'm ransomed by Your grace . A G#m Because of You, my heart has found a home .F#m7 B A refuge of my soul .E A Because of You, sins are washed away . F#m7 B E Because of You, heaven knows my name . A G#m F#m7 B E Because of You, I can live again You've broken every chain
[C1] . A E/G# A B Unfailing love, so unreserved, You gave Yourself on Calvary . A E/G# C#m7 F#m7 B E And now I stand forever free my Savior rescued me
[V2] .E A Because of You, the weak say "I am strong" . F#m7 B E Because of You, the broken have a song . A G#m Because of You, there's no need to fear .F#m7 B E Hope steadfast, ever sure
[B1] . E A Now heaven be open, Our God is unshaken . E B We worship Christ risen high above . E A Now heaven be open, All kingdoms, all nations . E B E Declare that You are God
